Flex Power Modules

Flex Power Modules is a global leader in advanced power conversion solutions. For over 45 years, we’ve delivered high-efficiency DC/DC converters that enable the performance and reliability demanded by today’s most critical applications—data centers, cloud computing, AI, telecom, industrial automation, and railway systems.

Product selector
Contact us

We are headquartered in Kalmar, Sweden, which is also home to one of our design centers. Our second design center and a manufacturing site are located in Shanghai, China, with additional production facilities in Penang, Malaysia, and Althofen, Austria.

Our board-mounted DC/DC modules

Flex offers a broad range of standard and custom embedded power solutions, including isolated and non-isolated, digital and analog DC/DC converters, Point of Load converters, Vertical Power Delivery, and a wide variety of tools and evaluation boards.

View our products

Explore our broad range of board-mounted DC/DC converters for data centers, telecom, and industrial applications.

Product selector

Our products combine cutting-edge design, digital control, and scalability to help customers optimize power density, thermal performance, and system integration. To simplify design and accelerate development, we offer Flex Power Designer, a powerful software tool for system-level simulation, thermal modeling, and configuration of our digital power modules.

With world-class engineering, automated manufacturing, and global support teams, Flex Power Modules ensures you stay ahead in a rapidly evolving technology landscape.

Designing and developing industry-specific DC/DC converters

We have taken into consideration application specific requirements and demands when designing and developing our DC/DC converters.

Product search
Data Center

Powering AI and hyperscale computing in the data center

AI, machine learning (ML), autonomous vehicles, cloud computing, and cryptocurrencies have caused the power levels in data centers to drastically increase. Data centers are forecasted to consume 1,000 terawatt hours annually by 2026, thus becoming one of the largest energy consumers globally.

To help minimize the environmental impact of this growth, Flex Power Modules offers smart, highly efficient, high power density power solutions, and our DC/DC converters contribute to reducing energy consumption and therefore lowering CO2 emissions in data centers.

We offer a multitude of isolated and non-isolated, regulated and unregulated DC/DC solutions up to 3.8 kW peak power to maximize system efficiency and hence minimize power dissipation.

Check out our full product offering for data center applications

DC/DC converters for AI data centers tackling space and thermal challenges

Vertical Power Delivery (VPD) modules

Our customized Vertical Power Delivery modules are designed ​to meet your xPU architecture and have the benefits of being:

  • Tailor-made for your performance and power needs
  • Mounted beneath the PCB, freeing valuable board space ​and improving thermal management
  • Optimized for efficiency, delivering high power density and reducing overall system footprint

Learn more about Vertical Power Delivery

Next-gen 800 VDC architecture modules

Our next-gen IBCs are optimized for both 800 V and ±400 V systems, enabling safe, compact, and thermally efficient power delivery to GPUs, CPUs, custom accelerators, and memory subsystems.

Learn more about our next-gen 800 VDC modules

Thermal management in data centers​

Managing heat is essential for the reliability and lifespan of power electronics. DC/DC converters generate heat due to switching and conduction power losses in the components (such as semiconductors, inductors, and capacitors) during the power conversion process.​ Effective thermal management prevents overheating, which can degrade the performance of the converter and cause component failure.​

Learn more about thermal management solutions

Solving power, heat, and scale challenges with integrated data center solutions

Telecom

Powering telecom applications

With a long-standing heritage in the telecom market, Flex Power Modules supports a wide range of applications including routers, switches, servers, base stations, optical networks, session border controllers, gateways, and other networking devices. We also provide solutions for RF Power Amplifier (RFPA) and microwave applications, enabling next-generation 5G/6G developments.​

Our DC/DC converter portfolio spans isolated and non-isolated, analog, and digital solutions from 1 W to 2,000 W, with typical telecom input ranges of 36–75 V.​

Aligned with the evolution of 5G networks, Flex collaborates closely with the O-RAN Alliance, a global community driving innovation in Radio Access Networks.​

Check out our full product offering for telecom applications

Industrial and Transportation

Providing smart industrial and transportation power solutions

Flex Power Modules’ robust DC/DC converters for industrial applications offer high reliability and are designed for harsh environments. Our converters feature wide temperature ranges, safety certifications (such as EN50155 for rail) and input-output isolation.

The industrial segment covers a huge range of applications typically requiring DC/DC solutions to operate from a 5. V, 12 V, or 24 V power supply.​

Check out our comprehensive industrial and transportation portfolio

Product selector

Our PKE, PKE-A, and PKU-S series deliver reliable power conversion ​for demanding industrial and transportation applications.

Designed for efficiency and durability, ​these converters offer wide input ranges, robust isolation,​ and compact encapsulate form factors to ensure stable power in harsh environments.​
